sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is the 27-billion-parameter dense member of the Qwen3.8 family, on the same hybrid-attention backbone as the 2.4T MoE flagship. The layer mix is the interesting part.
